notes: Steven Piano now keeps itself up to date: a new version shows on the Piano tab, and on the school tablet it installs without a tap. Share diagnostics sends the app's logs when something goes wrong.

Channels play your library without end: Calm, Epic, Baroque, Romantic, Impressionist, Nocturnes, Études and Everything, each at its own volume. Popular, Recognisable and Epic on piano fill themselves from your pieces. Left alone for a minute, the tablet becomes a display for passers-by. Every piece starts after a short pause, the score lights the notes it plays in yellow, a mini player (a now-playing panel on tablets) keeps the piece in sight, the controls float on frosted glass, the Piano tab's settings are grouped into pages, and Appearance can follow the system or stay light or dark.
